Ticking "Match the exact phrase" tightened it to just the one where "natural lighting" actually sits together as a phrase, which is what I meant when I typed it. That's the difference between "roughly these words somewhere" and "this exact thing," and having the choice is just right — loose by default for when I'm half-remembering, exact when I know the precise wording. Good.
